tasks.gr10-business-sectors-socio-economic-iss: Topic: Business sectors and socio-economic issues. Cover primary, secondary, tertiary sectors, formal/informal, public/private sectors, inequality, poverty, unemployment, HIV/AIDS. Ask about sector classification, impact questions, recommendation responses.
tasks.gr10-social-responsibility-forms-ownersh: Topic: Social responsibility and forms of ownership. Cover social responsibility, CSR, sole proprietor, partnership, non-profit company, profit companies, co-operatives. Ask about ownership advantages/disadvantages, comparisons, scenario-based recommendations.
tasks.gr10-entrepreneurial-qualities-t2: Topic: Entrepreneurial qualities (Grade 10 Business Studies, Term 2). Cover what an entrepreneur is, the CAPS list of qualities (desire for responsibility, risk taker, perseverance, leadership and management, confidence, energy, passion, vision, organisation, commitment, flexibility, willpower) and assessing yourself with scores. Ask Grade 10 learners directly (you); give all data in the question; name Acts only as areas of law, with no section numbers or thresholds.
tasks.gr10-socio-economic-issues-depth-t2: Topic: Contemporary socio-economic issues in depth (Grade 10 Business Studies, Term 2). Cover piracy, counterfeiting, gambling, pyramid schemes (illegal; growth by recruiting), crime, violence, strikes, inclusivity and business responses. Ask Grade 10 learners directly (you); give all data in the question; name Acts only as areas of law, with no section numbers or thresholds.
